name: Hale's White-Lead Pot
description: A small iron pot with a rope bail, crusted white at the lip, that Jory Pask found wedged under the Gannet's thwart: the lampwarden's pot. Ruan carried it the spring they took Jory out on the Teeth at seven. Jory held it out into the yard's fog until the white went grey: his one day out on the white behind his brother. A Remnant, given on purpose.
